mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation spike above 2.0% in CPIAUCSL triggers investor fear of higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals tightening monetary policy and weakening supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS rise and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) during a late-cycle expansion phase predicts peak market momentum, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth decelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.5% signals labor market weakness, dampening growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (HOUST) alongside tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) creates conflicting signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to market uncertainty.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) reflects weakening labor market conditions, compressing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (RSAFS) coupled with low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) signals a robust post-shock recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS rises and CPIAUCSL is below 2.0%.
